data.name: Alcohol QCM Sensor
data.abstract: Five different QCM gas sensors are used, and five different gas measurements (1-octanol, 1-propanol, 2-butanol, 2-propanol and 1-isobutanol) are conducted in each of these sensors.

intro_paper.title: Classification of alcohols obtained by QCM sensors with different characteristics using ABC based neural network
intro_paper.authors: M. F. Adak, P. Lieberzeit, P. Jarujamrus, N. Yumusak
intro_paper.venue: Engineering Science and Technology, an International Journal

additional_info.summary:
In the dataset there are 5 types of dataset.
QCM3, QCM6, QCM7, QCM10, QCM12

In each of dataset, There is alcohol classification of five types,
1-octanol, 1-propanol, 2-butanol, 2-propanol, 1-isobutanol
additional_info.variable_info:
The gas sample is passed through the sensor in five different concentrations. These concentrations are, 
Concentration	Air ratio (ml)	Gas ratio (ml)
1       0.799	0.201
2	0.700	0.300
3	0.600	0.400
4	0.501	0.499
5	0.400	0.600

There are two channels in the sensor. One of these circles forms channel 1, and the other forms channel 2. MIP and MP ratios used in the QCM sensors are,

Sensor name	MIP ratio	NP ratio
QCM3	1	1
QCM6	1	0
QCM7	1	0.5
QCM10	1	2
QCM12	0	1
